disclaimer: This information is for general awareness only and is not medical advice. For diagnosis or treatment, please consult a licensed healthcare professional.

entries.name: headache
entries.description: A sensation of pain anywhere in the region of the head or upper neck.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care for the worst headache of your life, sudden-onset severe headache, headache with fever and stiff neck, vision changes, weakness, confusion, or onset after head injury.

entries.name: fever
entries.description: Body temperature elevated above the normal range, typically 38°C (100.4°F) or higher.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Adults: seek care for temperature >39.4°C (103°F), fever lasting >3 days, severe headache, stiff neck, rash, persistent vomiting, difficulty breathing, or chest pain. Infants <3 months with any fever should be evaluated immediately.

entries.name: cough
entries.description: Sudden expulsion of air from the lungs through the airway, often a reflex to clear irritants.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for cough with bloody sputum, severe shortness of breath, high fever, chest pain, or cough lasting more than 3 weeks.

entries.name: chest pain
entries.description: Discomfort, pressure, or pain anywhere from the neck to the upper abdomen.
entries.whenToSeekCare: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES for chest pain that is severe, crushing, radiates to arm/jaw/back, occurs with shortness of breath, sweating, nausea, or lasts more than a few minutes — these can indicate a heart attack.

entries.name: shortness of breath
entries.description: A subjective sensation of difficult or uncomfortable breathing.
entries.whenToSeekCare: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES for sudden severe shortness of breath, breathing difficulty at rest, blue lips or fingertips, chest pain, or fainting.

entries.name: abdominal pain
entries.description: Pain felt anywhere between the chest and groin.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care for severe pain, pain with fever and vomiting, rigid or tender abdomen, blood in stool or vomit, or pain that wakes you from sleep.

entries.name: nausea
entries.description: Uneasiness of the stomach with an urge to vomit.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for nausea with severe abdominal pain, signs of dehydration, vomiting blood, severe headache, or lasting >48 hours.

entries.name: vomiting
entries.description: Forceful expulsion of stomach contents through the mouth.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care for vomiting blood, persistent vomiting >24h in adults or >12h in children, severe abdominal pain, signs of dehydration, or head injury.

entries.name: diarrhea
entries.description: Passage of three or more loose or liquid stools per day.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for bloody stools, severe dehydration, fever >39°C, severe abdominal pain, or diarrhea lasting >2 days in adults.

entries.name: fatigue
entries.description: Persistent feeling of physical or mental tiredness or weakness.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Discuss with a clinician if fatigue persists >2 weeks, interferes with daily activities, or is accompanied by weight changes, chest pain, or shortness of breath.

entries.name: dizziness
entries.description: Sensations of unsteadiness, spinning, or feeling faint.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care for dizziness with sudden severe headache, chest pain, fainting, slurred speech, weakness, vision changes, or after a head injury.

entries.name: rash
entries.description: A change in skin color or texture, often with bumps, blisters, or peeling.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care for rash with fever, blistering, peeling skin, breathing difficulty, swelling of face/throat, or rapid spread.

entries.name: sore throat
entries.description: Pain, scratchiness, or irritation of the throat that often worsens with swallowing.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for severe pain, difficulty breathing or swallowing, drooling, fever >38.3°C, swollen lymph nodes, or symptoms lasting >1 week.

entries.name: back pain
entries.description: Pain anywhere along the spine or back muscles.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care for back pain after major trauma, with leg weakness, loss of bladder/bowel control, fever, or unexplained weight loss.

entries.name: joint pain
entries.description: Discomfort, ache, or soreness in any of the body's joints.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for joint pain with significant swelling, redness, warmth, deformity, or inability to bear weight.

entries.name: runny nose
entries.description: Excess nasal drainage that may be thin and clear or thick and discolored.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Generally self-limiting. Seek care for high fever, severe facial pain, symptoms lasting >10 days, or thick green/yellow discharge with facial pressure.

entries.name: sneezing
entries.description: Sudden, forceful, involuntary expulsion of air through the nose and mouth.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Rarely emergent. Discuss with a clinician if persistent or accompanied by significant other symptoms.

entries.name: muscle pain
entries.description: Aching or soreness in one or more muscles.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for muscle pain that is severe, accompanied by dark urine, weakness, fever, or after starting a new medication (especially statins).

entries.name: swelling
entries.description: Enlargement of body parts due to fluid build-up or inflammation.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care for sudden swelling of face/lips/tongue, swelling with breathing difficulty, calf pain with swelling (possible blood clot), or abdominal swelling with pain.

entries.name: constipation
entries.description: Infrequent bowel movements or difficulty passing stool, typically <3 times per week.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for constipation with severe pain, blood in stool, unexplained weight loss, or sudden change in bowel habits lasting >2 weeks.

entries.name: heartburn
entries.description: Burning sensation in the chest behind the breastbone, often after eating.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care if heartburn is severe, occurs with shortness of breath or arm/jaw pain (possible heart attack), or causes difficulty swallowing.

entries.name: ear pain
entries.description: Pain in or around the ear.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for severe pain, fever, drainage from the ear, hearing loss, dizziness, or pain after head injury.

entries.name: blurred vision
entries.description: Lack of sharpness of vision, with objects appearing out of focus.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek urgent care for sudden vision loss, vision changes with severe headache, eye pain, or symptoms of stroke (weakness, slurred speech).

entries.name: insomnia
entries.description: Persistent difficulty falling or staying asleep, despite the opportunity to sleep.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Discuss with a clinician if insomnia persists >1 month, impairs daily function, or is accompanied by mood changes or loud snoring.

entries.name: anxiety
entries.description: Persistent feelings of worry, unease, or fear, often with physical symptoms like a racing heart.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care if anxiety interferes with daily life, includes panic attacks, or co-occurs with thoughts of self-harm. Mental-health emergencies warrant urgent help.

entries.name: weight loss
entries.description: A decrease in body weight that is not the result of intentional diet or exercise.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Discuss with a clinician for unintentional loss of >5% body weight over 6–12 months, or any weight loss accompanied by other concerning symptoms.

entries.name: hives
entries.description: Raised, itchy bumps or welts on the skin, often pink or red.
entries.whenToSeekCare: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES for hives with breathing difficulty, swelling of lips/tongue/throat, dizziness, or rapid heart rate — these can indicate anaphylaxis.

entries.name: swollen lymph nodes
entries.description: Enlarged lymph nodes, often felt as lumps in the neck, armpit, or groin.
commonCauses: less commonly, lymphoma or other cancers
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for nodes that are persistently enlarged >2 weeks, hard or fixed in place, accompanied by fever, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss.

entries.name: frequent urination
entries.description: The need to urinate more often than usual.
entries.whenToSeekCare: Seek care for frequent urination with pain or burning, blood in urine, fever, abdominal/back pain, or excessive thirst with weight loss.

entries.name: leg swelling
entries.description: Excess fluid build-up in the legs, ankles, or feet.
entries.whenToSeekCare: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES for sudden leg swelling with pain or warmth (possible blood clot), or swelling with breathing difficulty or chest pain.
